key_concepts: A solution is a homogeneous mixture of one or more solutes dissolved in a solvent
The solute is the substance dissolved; the solvent is the substance that dissolves the sol
Solution particles are invisible to the naked eye, do not scatter light, and cannot be sep
Solutions can be liquid, solid, or gas depending on the state of the solvent
Water is called the universal solvent
Soluble substances dissolve in a solvent; insoluble substances do not
Miscible liquids mix in all proportions; immiscible liquids separate after mixing
Solubility is the maximum amount of solute that dissolves in a given amount of solvent at
The nature of the solute and solvent affects solubility
Stirring increases how quickly a solute dissolves
Amount of solvent and size of solute particles affect solubility
